xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Access read includes Content persistence and owner/admin bypass; nonowners/nonadmins use Friend policy.
Source assignment after selection occurs only in onDismiss callback with a pending ID.
Episode-data pagination and playback asset windows remain independent; rendered/device behavior is unverified.
